notes: Page numbers are PDF pages of main.pdf; PDF p. 1 is the publisher cover page. The measured sorbent is the as-prepared graphitic nanofibre Fe-GNF 9 (carbon_nanofiber), BET by N2 on a Quantachrome Autosorb 1 (main p. 3). It is not purified: XRD detects Fe3C in Fe-GNF 9 (main p. 4). The paper gives no carbon mass fraction, but carbon is taken as the majority component from the reported yield (4·489 g gcat−1 h−1 over a 4 h run with 0·05 g Fe2O3 loaded). Uptake is a 77 K gravimetric isotherm to 20 bar (Fig. 4, adsorption and desorption branches); the text calls 0·643 wt-% a maximum at the highest measured pressure. Table 1 values (Refs 6-10) are quoted from other work and are not the paper's measurements. No statement of prior publication of the data; record is not flagged retracted and the PDF has no retraction notice.
